question: How much IBNR is held in total across all accident years at 31 December 2025?
final_text:
Total IBNR held at 31 December 2025 is **£5,248,275.43**, summed across accident years 2019 to 2025.

| Accident year | IBNR (£) |
|---|---|
| 2019 | 0.00 |
| 2020 | 1,540.89 |
| 2021 | 38,210.26 |
| 2022 | 163,122.73 |
| 2023 | 184,880.76 |
| 2024 | 611,435.82 |
| 2025 | 4,249,084.97 |

The query returned no accident years before 2019, so I've treated the total as complete. The 2025 accident year accounts for about 81% of the total.

ANSWER: 5248275.43
